topic: How does L-DACS integration impact spectrum sharing between A2G and satellite links in congested airspaces?
consensus_response: L-DACS integration with A2G and satellite links in congested airspaces leads to increased interference due to overlapping frequencies, particularly when operating on the same frequencies without proper coordination. Rician distributed fading exacerbates this issue. Cognitive radio techniques can mitigate this problem, but direct-to-satellite architecture's long distance and spectrum allocation issues complicate the problem. The extremely long distance between transmitter (the satellite) and receiver (the terminal) increases the e2e latency of a satellite IoT system, making it larger than that provided by mobile networks or LPWANs.
